point: stay + 持續的狀態：用 until，不用 by。
why: The verb is must stay parked: a state that lasts, not an action finished once. It lasts until the repair is done (when the contractor expects to finish), so the word is until.
動詞是 must stay parked：這是持續的狀態，不是做一次就完成的動作。狀態持續到維修完成（when the contractor expects to finish）為止，所以用 until。

gloss.ex: The ship docked at the quay at dawn.
The crane lowered its boom slowly.
The contractor finished the roof early.
Each brake assembly is tested twice.

point: within + 一段時間 + of + 起算事件。
why: Far from the blank, of receiving it shows the pattern within seven days of …: seven days counted from receipt. The clause or the carrier may reject confirms it is a limit: within.
離空格很遠的 of receiving it 顯示句型 within seven days of …：從收到起算七天。or the carrier may reject 也說明這是期限：within。

gloss.ex: Customers may lodge a complaint online.
The price excludes shipping costs.
The carrier delivered the crate on Monday.
The office closes on public holidays.

point: A specific day's morning: on the morning of.
特定某一天的上午：on the morning of。
why: the morning of the first day points to one particular day, so the preposition is on. in the morning is only for a general morning.
the morning of the first day 指的是特定的某一天，所以介系詞用 on。in the morning 只用在泛指的上午。

gloss.ex: Each delegate received a name badge.
Please wear your badge at all times.
The registration booth opens at eight.

why: eleven consecutive months is a length of time, so use for. during takes the name of an event or period, not a number plus a unit.
eleven consecutive months 是時間長度，所以用 for。during 後面接事件或時期的名稱，不接數字加單位。

gloss.ex: Engineers overhauled the engine last winter.
Sales rose for six consecutive quarters.
The maintenance contract expires in June.

point: run ahead of a forecast: better than predicted.
run ahead of 預測：比預測更好。
why: The ending surprised planners who expected the model to sell slowly, and a second shift is needed. Sales beat the forecast, so ahead of. in line with would mean no surprise.
句尾 surprised planners who expected the model to sell slowly，還需要 second shift。銷量超過預測，所以用 ahead of。in line with 代表不會令人意外。

gloss.ex: The sales forecast was revised in May.
The planners reviewed the schedule.
Workers on the second shift start at two.

why: from the executive floor … to the smallest regional depot and no department exempt: the code covers every part of the organization. That meaning is throughout. through means passing through.
from the executive floor … to the smallest regional depot 與 no department 有豁免：準則涵蓋組織每一處。這個意思是 throughout。through 表示穿過。

gloss.ex: New staff must read the code of conduct.
Trucks leave the depot at six.
The rule allows no exemption for contractors.

point: in response to + an event that already happened.
in response to + 已經發生的事。
why: the outage … that was reported last week has already happened, and the refinery reacted to it. rather than waiting for the regulator also shows a reaction: in response to.
the outage … that was reported last week 已經發生，煉油廠對它作出反應。rather than waiting for the regulator 也顯示是反應：in response to。

gloss.ex: The refinery processes oil from three fields.
The firm trimmed its costs by ten percent.
The outage lasted about two hours.
The regulator approved the new tariff.

why: ever since a strike halted production and asked the Bexley depot to fill the order both show the fittings are not available here. The phrase is out of stock.
ever since a strike halted production 與 asked the Bexley depot to fill the order 都顯示這裡沒有貨。片語是 out of stock。

gloss.ex: We stock several valve fittings.
Heavy snow halted deliveries for two days.
The depot can fill the order today.

why: remain ______ review while the legal team checks says the bids are still being examined. The fixed phrase is under review.
remain ______ review while the legal team checks 表示標案仍在審查。固定片語是 under review。

gloss.ex: We received six bids for the project.
Please upload your insurance documents.

point: in advance of + an event: before it.
in advance of + 事件：在它之前。
why: a request that gave the accounts team less than a week to trace the missing receipts shows the invoices were due before the visit. The phrase is in advance of their visit.
a request that gave the accounts team less than a week to trace the missing receipts 顯示發票要在來訪前交齊。片語是 in advance of their visit。

gloss.ex: The auditors arrive on Monday.
Attach the supporting invoices to the claim.
We could not trace the missing parcel.
Keep all receipts for the audit.

point: with regard to + 主題：關於。
why: queries ______ your travel expense claim means queries about the claim. questions about the booking itself then sends the other kind of question elsewhere. The phrase is with regard to.
queries ______ your travel expense claim 指關於申請的問題。questions about the booking itself 則把另一類問題轉給別處。片語是 with regard to。

gloss.ex: Send your queries to the help desk.
She filed an expense claim on Friday.
The desk handles all hotel reservations.

why: he has asked to hand it over to a successor shows he holds the responsibility now. A duty can be handed over; a view cannot. The phrase is in charge of.
he has asked to hand it over to a successor 顯示他現在擔負這項職責。職責可以交接，立場不行。片語是 in charge of。

gloss.ex: The deputy director signed the form.
The briefing starts at nine.
The pilot scheme runs for six months.
She trained her successor carefully.
